samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag indicating if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag indicating if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag indicating if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag indicating if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">Flag for special operations like SLT and SLTU.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to hold the result.</reg>
        <wire id="a_signed" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input a.</wire>
        <wire id="b_signed" width_description="[31:0]">Signed version of input b.</wire>
        
        // Assigning inputs to signed wires
        assign a_signed = $signed(a);
        assign b_signed = $signed(b);
        // Assigning the result to the output port
        assign r = res[31:0];
        // Assigning flags based on the control signal
        assign flag = (aluc == 6'b101010 || aluc == 6'b101011) ? 1'b1 : 1'bz;
        // Assigning zero flag
        assign zero = (res == 32'h00000000) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        // Assigning negative flag
        assign negative = (res[31] == 1'b1) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        // Assigning overflow flag
        assign overflow = ((aluc == 6'b100000 && (a_signed > 0 && b_signed > 0 && res <= 0)) ||
                          (aluc == 6'b100001 && (a >= 0 && b >= 0 && res <= 0)) ||
                          (aluc == 6'b100010 && (a_signed < 0 && b_signed < 0 && res >= 0)) ||
                          (aluc == 6'b100011 && (a < 0 && b < 0 && res >= 0))) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        // Assigning carry flag
        assign carry = (aluc == 6'b100001 && (a + b >= 32'hFFFFFFFF)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        reg [31:0] res;
        always @(*) begin
            case(aluc)
                6'b100000: res = a + b; // ADD
                6'b100001: res = a + b; // ADDU
                6'b100010: res = a - b; // SUB
                6'b100011: res = a - b; // SUBU
                6'b100100: res = a & b; // AND
                6'b100101: res = a | b; // OR
                6'b100110: res = a ^ b; // XOR
                6'b100111: res = ~(a | b); // NOR
                6'b101010: res = (a_signed < b_signed) ? 1 : 0; // SLT
                6'b101011: res = (a < b) ? 1 : 0; // SLTU
                6'b000000: res = b << a[4:0]; // SLL
                6'b000010: res = b >> a[4:0]; // SRL
                6'b000011: res = b >>> a[4:0]; // SRA
                6'b000100: res = b << a; // SLLV
                6'b000110: res = b >> a; // SRLV
                6'b000111: res = b >>> a; // SRAV
                6'b001111: res = {a[15:0], 16'b0}; // LUI
                default: res = 32'bz; // Default case
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
